Package com.j3d.engine.math.rot

Class Rotation

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.engine.math.rot.Rotation
public class Rotation extends Object
Represents an object's orientation in 3D space using Tait-Bryan angles (yaw, pitch, and roll).

This class stores angles in degrees and provides methods to generate transformation matrices for converting vectors between world space and a local (camera) space. It acts as a factory for CamToWorldDirection and WorldToCamDirection transformers.

The primary matrix generated via RotationMatrixDirection.matrix() is the view matrix, which transforms coordinates from the world space into the camera's local space.

Author:
Lehlogonolo Poole
